#!/bin/sh
set -eu
src=/etc/inventory/app.conf
remote_host=10.100.226.11
key=/root/.ssh/inventory_sync_ed25519
known_hosts=/root/.ssh/known_hosts

remote_tmp=/etc/inventory/.app.conf.sync.$$

uid=$(stat -c %u "$local_tmp")
gid=$(stat -c %g "$local_tmp")
ssh -i "$key" -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile="$known_hosts" -o ConnectTimeout=10 root@"$remote_host" 'install -d -m 755 /etc/inventory'

ANTRIEB_SYNC_EOF
